prompt: Refactor this Python function used in a hot path. It builds many temp dicts and repeatedly lowercases keys in a loop. Improve clarity and performance without changing behavior.
criteria: identifies algorithmic or layout issues before micro-optimizations
calls out allocation churn or hidden copies
preserves readability and behavior invariants
proposes measurable validation approach
mentions rollback/safety or risk containment

prompt: Design CI/CD for Terraform + app deploy across dev/stage/prod with fast release flow and low outage risk.
criteria: uses small batches and fast feedback
defines promotion gates and rollback strategy
covers infra drift/state locking/secrets
names key failure modes and detection
balances speed vs reliability trade-off

prompt: Deep dive: idempotent job processing with at-least-once delivery and out-of-order events.
criteria: states consistency/ordering trade-offs
defines idempotency key strategy
addresses replay and duplicate handling
specifies observability/metrics
explains failure recovery path

prompt: An agent workflow adds a broad reusable skill and a long-lived project memory after one successful task. A later task in a different domain starts following the old procedure, retrieves stale context, and gives confident but wrong advice. Evaluate whether these skill and memory changes are actually improvements.
criteria: judges skill and memory changes by downstream task utility
checks for negative transfer across domains, models, or target agents
requires provenance for memory and skill entries
identifies stale memory, retrieval mismatch, or context pollution
defines pressure-test or benchmark evidence plus rollback/repair path
anti: assumes more memory or more skill text is always better
judges skill quality by polish or completeness only
no way to remove or repair bad memory
